tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), error rate 18%. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error, leaving regions mixed (us-east v2.3.0, us-west/eu-west v2.3.1). The retry finished in all regions. Current state: v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, eu-west; healthy; error rate 0.2%. Follow-ups: root-cause the v2.3.1 regression, find out why an RC that failed in staging was promoted to production, and investigate the orchestrator error during rollback.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged the on-call engineer.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1, the latest deploy, was unhealthy in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to that.
  - The first attempt stopped after us-east with an orchestrator error. That left us-east on v2.3.0 while us-west and eu-west were still on v2.3.1.
  - Rolling back to v2.3.0 is safe to repeat, so I tried again and it finished in all regions.
  - checkout-api now reports healthy, with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Incident:** The first request to create it timed out. I resent it with the same idempotency key so it couldn't create a duplicate incident or page twice. There's only one incident in the list. Its summary covers the failure, the rollback (including the partial failure) and the current state.

The incident also lists three things to follow up:
- Find the cause of the v2.3.1 problem.
- Find out why v2.3.1 went to production when its release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, had also failed health checks in staging.
- Investigate the orchestrator error that stopped the first rollback.

No change-manager approval was needed, because v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production.
